description: This file is a controller class for the OpenCart e-commerce platform, specifically for the 'Fixer' currency extension. It handles displaying the configuration UI, saving settings, and fetching currency exchange rates from the Fixer.io API.

classes.name: Fixer
classes.description: Controller class for managing Fixer.io currency integration, including configuration display, saving settings, and fetching exchange rates.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the Fixer currency extension configuration page with form fields and UI components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the currency fixer API settings after validating permissions and input.

methods.name: currency
methods.description: Fetches latest currency rates from Fixer.io API and updates the local currency data accordingly.
